rule: A new classification head / fine-tuned model is adopted only if: 1. Mean UAR Gain: >= +0.03 gain over frozen zero-shot baseline in actor-grouped dev cross-validation. 2. Consistency: Achieves higher UAR in a strict majority of CV folds. 3. Safety / Vulnerable Classes: Per-class recall on sad and neutral must NOT regress compared to baseline.
